Target IaC language: AWS CloudFormation (YAML)

Task: Write a CloudFormation template provisioning an ECS Fargate cluster running two microservices behind an internal Network Load Balancer.

Output only the AWS CloudFormation (YAML) code, no commentary or markdown fences.
raw_response:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: ECS Fargate cluster with two microservices behind internal NLB

Parameters:
  VpcId:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC::Id
    Description: VPC ID for the ECS cluster
  SubnetIds:
    Type: List<AWS::EC2::Subnet::Id>
    Description: Subnet IDs for ECS tasks
  Service1Image:
    Type: String
    Default: nginx:latest
    Description: Docker image for service 1
  Service2Image:
    Type: String
    Default: httpd:latest
    Description: Docker image for service 2
  Service1Port:
    Type: Number
    Default: 80
    Description: Port for service 1
  Service2Port:
    Type: Number
    Default: 80
    Description: Port for service 2

Metadata:
  AWS::CloudFormation::Interface:
    ParameterGroups:
      - Label:
          default: Network Configuration
        Parameters:
          - VpcId
          - SubnetIds
      - Label:
          default: Service Configuration
        Parameters:
          - Service1Image
          - Service2Image
          - Service1Port
          - Service2Port

Resources:
  ECSCluster:
    Type: AWS::ECS::Cluster
    Properties:
      ClusterName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-cluster"
      ClusterSettings:
        - Name: containerInsights
          Value: enabled

  TaskExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ecs-tasks.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AmazonECSTaskExecutionRolePolicy

  Service1TaskDefinition:
    Type: AWS::ECS::TaskDefinition
    Properties:
      Family: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-service1"
      NetworkMode: awsvpc
      RequiresCompatibilities:
        - FARGATE
      Cpu: "256"
      Memory: "512"
      ExecutionRoleArn: !Ref TaskExecutionRole
      ContainerDefinitions:
        - Name: service1
          Image: !Ref Service1Image
          PortMappings:
            - ContainerPort: !Ref Service1Port
              Protocol: tcp

  Service2TaskDefinition:
    Type: AWS::ECS::TaskDefinition
    Properties:
      Family: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-service2"
      NetworkMode: awsvpc
      RequiresCompatibilities:
        - FARGATE
      Cpu: "256"
      Memory: "512"
      ExecutionRoleArn: !Ref TaskExecutionRole
      ContainerDefinitions:
        - Name: service2
          Image: !Ref Service2Image
          PortMappings:
            - ContainerPort: !Ref Service2Port
              Protocol: tcp

  LoadBalancerSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for internal NLB
      VpcId: !Ref VpcId
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 80
          ToPort: 80
          CidrIp: 10.0.0.0/8
          Description: Allow HTTP from VPC

  ServiceSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for ECS services
      VpcId: !Ref VpcId
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: !Ref Service1Port
          ToPort: !Ref Service1Port
          SourceSecurityGroupId: !Ref LoadBalancerSecurityGroup
          Description: Allow service 1 port from NLB
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: !Ref Service2Port
          ToPort: !Ref Service2Port
          SourceSecurityGroupId: !Ref LoadBalancerSecurityGroup
          Description: Allow service 2 port from NLB

  LoadBalancer:
    Type: AWS::ElasticLoadBalancingV2::LoadBalancer
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-nlb"
      Type: network
      Scheme: internal
      Subnets: !Ref SubnetIds
      SecurityGroups:
        - !Ref LoadBalancerSecurityGroup

  Service1TargetGroup:
    Type: AWS::ElasticLoadBalancingV2::TargetGroup
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-service1-tg"
      Port: !Ref Service1Port
      Protocol: TCP
      VpcId: !Ref VpcId
      TargetType: ip
      HealthCheckProtocol: HTTP
      HealthCheckPath: /
      HealthCheckPort: !Ref Service1Port

  Service2TargetGroup:
    Type: AWS::ElasticLoadBalancingV2::TargetGroup
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-service2-tg"
      Port: !Ref Service2Port
      Protocol: TCP
      VpcId: !Ref VpcId
      TargetType: ip
      HealthCheckProtocol: HTTP
      HealthCheckPath: /
      HealthCheckPort: !Ref Service2Port

  LoadBalancerListener:
    Type: AWS::ElasticLoadBalancingV2::Listener
    Properties:
      DefaultActions:
        - Type: forward
          TargetGroupArn: !Ref Service1TargetGroup
      LoadBalancerArn: !Ref LoadBalancer
      Port: 80
      Protocol: TCP

  Service1:
    Type: AWS::ECS::Service
    Properties:
      ServiceName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-service1"
      Cluster: !Ref ECSCluster
      TaskDefinition: !Ref Service1TaskDefinition
      DesiredCount: 2
      LaunchType: FARGATE
      NetworkConfiguration:
        AwsvpcConfiguration:
          Subnets: !Ref SubnetIds
          SecurityGroups:
            - !Ref ServiceSecurityGroup
      LoadBalancers:
        - TargetGroupArn: !Ref Service1TargetGroup
          ContainerName: service1
          ContainerPort: !Ref Service1Port
    DependsOn:
      - LoadBalancerListener

  Service2:
    Type: AWS::ECS::Service
    Properties:
      ServiceName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-service2"
      Cluster: !Ref ECSCluster
      TaskDefinition: !Ref Service2TaskDefinition
      DesiredCount: 2
      LaunchType: FARGATE
      NetworkConfiguration:
        AwsvpcConfiguration:
          Subnets: !Ref SubnetIds
          SecurityGroups:
            - !Ref ServiceSecurityGroup
      LoadBalancers:
        - TargetGroupArn: !Ref Service2TargetGroup
          ContainerName: service2
          ContainerPort: !Ref Service2Port
    DependsOn:
      - LoadBalancerListener

Outputs:
  LoadBalancerDNS:
    Description: Internal NLB DNS name
    Value: !GetAtt LoadBalancer.DNSName
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-LoadBalancerDNS"

  Service1Endpoint:
    Description: Service 1 endpoint
    Value: !Sub "http://${LoadBalancer.DNSName}"
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-Service1Endpoint"

  Service2Endpoint:
    Description: Service 2 endpoint (requires custom routing)
    Value: !Sub "http://${LoadBalancer.DNSName}"
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-Service2Endpoint"
